script: If you’re in Broward and want a local men’s pro team to follow, put Fort Lauderdale United on your list. Their new USL League One side is set to start in spring twenty twenty-seven. They’ll share Amerant Bank Field in Davie with the women’s team, which is already playing. That gives fans a way to get to know the club before the men’s season begins. You can go to a women’s match now, learn the ground, and decide who you’re bringing back next spring.
spokenStyle: A knowledgeable local friend explaining why this matters; conversational, unhurried, no sales-announcer voice.
